what: With the default EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1, every fabric-mesh test fails with L1ProfilingError peak_total=0: graph capture records no circular_buffer_allocate nodes on a MeshDevice (native ttnn.add on the same mesh also gives 0). 765/773 golden failures were this instrumentation error, which cost a full ~25 min golden run plus a root-cause investigation
suggest: fix MeshDevice CB tracking in graph capture, or have l1_profiling skip/exempt multi-device mesh fixtures; until then, tell CCL-op agents to run golden with EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=0

what: classify_call records num_links raw (None), but the op canonicalizes None to the discovered count before its gate, so every translated test (default num_links) lands outside SUPPORTED: 7 xpass_drift + 199 xfail_wrong_mode of pure classification noise
suggest: canonicalize num_links=None in classify_call (same as the op), or have golden-tests document that SUPPORTED must list None

what: The golden runner takes 25-30 min for a CCL op (precompile about 7 min plus run), but the Bash tool caps at 10 min, so a foreground run as written gets killed. When another agent holds the device, the runner also aborts after 900 s waiting for the lock
suggest: tell the verifier to launch eval_test_runner.sh detached (setsid nohup) with a retry-on-lock-timeout loop and to poll the log

what: Negative tests that assert the op refuses a cell (e.g. test_pre_all_gather_non_welford_fp32_requires_fp32_dest_acc) pass because validate() refused, but are reported as xpass_drift, a loud category that cannot be cleaned
suggest: let translated expect-raise tests mark themselves (e.g. a marker) so the CLI classifies them as expected rejections
